# `cellfeat`

Build resumable cohort-only IMC cell features using full-segmentation context

- Wrapper: [`job_cell_features.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_cell_features.sh)
- Conda environment: `sbt-analysis`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.cell_features`

## Inputs

- napari_sbt.active_experiment manifest, frozen cohort, masks, and selected channel images

## Outputs

- napari_sbt experiment feature Parquet, dictionary, coverage, failure, and provenance assets

## Configuration

- general, napari_sbt, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl cellfeat
```
